A few years back I had the privilege of attending a few lectures of Hazrat Moulana Anzar Shah Saheb (DB) in my local masjid. Since then, I have had a few dreams about him and would like to know their meanings. 1. I had a dream that Moulana Saheb (DB) was very weak and was about to break into pieces inside my local masjid and I was carrying him and trying to get help for him. Others were also trying to help, e.g. my brothers and friends but I did not let them and I said to then that they don't know how to help him and that only I could do this. 2. I had a dream that I wa following Hazrat Moulana (DB) around the UK as he was delivering various talks around the country and that I was also studying under him at the same time whilst he travelled around. 3. I had another dream about a famous Scholar in the UK. I dreamt that He was teaching (dars) in the dar ul uloom where he teaches. I dreamt that I was sitting infront of him and that he requested me to read and explain the book he was doing a dars of and I refused saying "How can I read anything in your presence" but he insisted and so I began reading the book. However, as soon as I started reading, the respected Scholar got up hastily and left the room and everyone followed him out. 1457 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 32108 Country: India Title: I am a gril & my uncle had seen a dream of mine in which he sees that I had died and my body is not in kafan for burring but the same cloth which I had wore at death time, Question: I am a gril & my uncle had seen a dream of mine in which he sees that I had died and my body is not in kafan for burring but the same cloth which I had wore at death time, & around my janaza there are flowers & chadder on which arabic quotes are written but all can see my body through. they picked my body to go to grave yard but they took my body to a like ground, they kept my body down there and every body left from there telling my uncle you wait here we will back in 5 min. there is no light on the ground, every were their is dark but a light is felling on my janaza. my uncle think in his mind that why her body seems to be so fresh and no bad odors are coming though she died two days earlier. he got afraid and try to run but while he was escaping i catch her hand, any how he succeeded from escaping there. he gone home and told every body that she is alive, they brought my body back my home. and I got up with out bending my body. every body got afraid and began to run here & there. Answer ID: 32108 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 838/311/TL=1432) This is nice dream, ma-shaAllah. But, it indicates to laziness in you towards righteousness and good deeds which was pointed out by the darkness. You should try your best to carry out good deeds, ultimately it will bring good results in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
